title: Authoring and editing phonological rules
description: A regular rewrite rule shares its Input, name and direction across one or more right-hand sides. Each right-hand side has its own Output, left and right environments, required and excluded rule features, and optional input categories. Input and Output each contain up to eight ordered phoneme or natural-class items. Empty Input means insertion; empty Output means deletion. Context items can be optional or repeated and can name word and morpheme boundaries.
